name: add_page_collaboration
reason: Skills use page_work and work_session. Addressed page messages are that inbox, not a skill of their own.

name: archive_space
reason: Archiving the space is an owner action. These skills do not archive a space.

name: checkout_change_status
reason: Skills name the checkout and land_canonical_change. Polling one landing is that checkout's follow-up.

name: copy_to_github
reason: A one-way GitHub copy is an Accounts action, not a skill workflow.

name: create_space
reason: Creating a space is the start page. These skills enter a space that already exists.

name: explain_node
reason: Skills say to read_node and cite the path. They do not add a plain-language rewrite.

name: export_agent_team
reason: make-an-agent registers one profile. It does not export the whole team.

name: harvest_notes
reason: Skills say when to leave a note. Gathering notes into one review is a separate pass.

name: invite_member
reason: The README says a machine invite is refused. No skill invites a person.

name: issue_tool_permit
reason: Skills name checkout and call_provider. A local gateway permit is that checkout's detail.

name: land_scoped_change
reason: Skills name land_canonical_change. A member's scoped land is the other checkout path.

name: list_members
reason: start already returns the team. Skills do not list members as their own step.

name: list_nodes
reason: Skills route with find_process and search. They do not directory-list the space.

name: list_notes
reason: Skills say when to leave a note. They do not list the notes already standing.

name: move_files_to_storage
reason: Moving large files out of Git is owner maintenance, not a skill workflow.

name: onboarding_answer
reason: First-run answers belong to setup. These skills assume the space already exists.

name: onboarding_propose
reason: Raising the first-run decision belongs to setup. These skills assume the space already exists.

name: onboarding_review
reason: Reviewing the first-run diff belongs to setup. These skills assume the space already exists.

name: open_mainmind
reason: Opening the space view only reads. Skills call start.

name: page_collaboration
reason: Skills read the inbox with page_work. The full page discussion is that inbox's detail.

name: page_history
reason: Skills cite the current page from start. They do not walk earlier versions.

name: read_source_context
reason: Skills copy files with source_file_upload. Extracted evidence from a saved original is a separate read.

name: renew_checkout_lease
reason: Skills name the checkout. Renewing its lease is what the checkout says to do when it expires.

name: restore_agent_team
reason: make-an-agent registers one profile. Restoring a whole team is the export's pair.

name: retire_members
reason: Retiring bots needs the person's yes. No skill retires members.

name: retract_note
reason: Skills say when to leave a note. Withdrawing one is the author's later correction.

name: review_checkout_tools
reason: Previewing the tool inventory is a Founder checkout check. Skills do not review tools.

name: revoke_member
reason: Removing a person is an owner proposal. No skill removes members.

name: revoke_provider_connection
reason: connections-and-secrets adds and reseals a connection. It does not revoke one.

name: rotate_member_credential
reason: Rotating a machine credential is team administration. Skills say not to hand over a token.

name: run_receipt
reason: Skills finish a run with run_finish. Reading that run's receipt is not a step they teach.

name: save_source_file
reason: Skills use source_file_upload. The small-byte save is that upload's other entry.

name: space_health
reason: Health is the space dashboard. These skills do not open it.

name: under_strain
reason: Strain is the health view's detail. These skills do not open it.

name: update_page_collaboration
reason: Skills update addressed work with work_session. This tool updates an unaddressed page task.

name: what_changed
reason: Skills cite the commit start returns. They do not ask what changed since a time.

name: what_points_here
reason: Skills read the matched process. They do not ask what else links to it.

name: work_context
reason: continue-with-my-agent reads the home sync returns. Page-conversation context is the inbox's detail.
